title: CAB PR EXCESS CAB ALT
announce: ECAM, cabin pressure, excess cabin altitude.

actions.say: Crew oxygen masks, on, one hundred percent, and establish communication.
If the cabin altitude is uncontrollable, initiate an emergency descent.
If the cabin altitude climbs above fourteen thousand feet, passenger oxygen masks, manually on.

status: Status. Cabin altitude excessive; pressurisation is being managed.
Target ten thousand feet or the minimum safe altitude, whichever is higher.
A.T.C., declare an emergency and advise intentions.
